explication: TRaSH-Guides is a static documentation product for configuring Radarr, Sonarr, Prowlarr, download clients, media servers, and storage layouts. The principal workflow is: a media-server user opens the guide site, selects an application or infrastructure topic, and receives setup guidance, recommended settings, or reusable JSON definitions. The tree shows content and structured data clearly; implementation details of site generation are intentionally omitted. The validation scripts confirm relationships among profiles, custom formats, groups, and source specifications but are not product runtime components.
